title: Imidazolium-Functionalized Anthraquinone for High-Capacity Electrochemical CO2 Capture

compounds.name: [BAQMIM][TFSA]
compounds.quote: we synthesized an ionically modified anthraquinone, 1-butyl-3-((2′-anthraquinoyl)methyl)imidazolium bis-(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)amide ([BAQMIM][TFSA])

compounds.name: anthraquinone
compounds.quote: AQ (2.5 mM) in the same electrolyte solution was also studied as a reference.

conditions.quote: The redox behavior of [BAQMIM][TFSA] was initially investigated by CV measurements using 2.5 mM [BAQMIM][TFSA] in DMSO containing 1 M [P13][TFSA] as a supporting electrolyte.
The electrolyte was bubbled and saturated with argon (>99.99%) or CO2 (>99.5%) for 30 min prior to the measurements.
The CO2 capture capacity was additionally estimated by constant-potential electrolysis at a reductive potential (−1.4 V vs Ag/Ag+) under CO2.

measurements.quote: The half-wave potential (E1/2) of [BAQMIM][TFSA] (E1/2 = −1.15 V) shows a slightly positive shift in the redox potential compared with that of the pristine AQ
compared with that of the pristine AQ (E1/2 = −1.19 V) due to the electron-withdrawing effect of the positively charged butylimidazolium pendant.
a radical anion forms at the first cathodic potential (E1 = −1.15 V) and the dianion forms at the second reduction step (E2 = −1.75 V)

observations.quote: the nucleophilic oxygen atom of Q·−chemically reacts with CO2 to form a carboxylated quinone radical anion (Q(CO2)·−).

not_reported: Capture capacity in MmolPerGram or MolPerMol
